source_facts.fact: Ofgem's 16 June 2026 update says demand connections reform is addressing a large and growing queue, non-viable blockers and the lack of a mechanism to prioritise strategic demand.
source_facts.gate: Policy reform objectives do not establish priority or a connection date for a specific project.

source_facts.fact: NESO states the current queue exceeds 738 GW while 200–225 GW of clean generation capacity is required by 2030.
source_facts.gate: System-wide queue and capacity targets must not be downscaled to a parcel or substation.

source_facts.fact: Ofgem agreed a re-baselined batched offer timetable in June 2026, with the final batch expected by mid-March 2027.
source_facts.gate: Programme milestones are not individual connection dates.

source_facts.fact: NESO reported 713 of 1,223 pre-2030 projects had received offers by 10 June 2026, representing 58% and 37 GW.
source_facts.gate: Portfolio progress is not evidence of an offer or capacity for an unverified project.

source_facts.fact: NESO states Gate 1 does not reserve capacity, a queue place, protected status or a guaranteed connection.
source_facts.gate: Gate 1 must fail closed for capacity reservation.

source_facts.fact: UKPN publishes historical and near-real-time transformer and constraint information, including half-hourly GSP/SGT measurements and curtailment-related datasets.
source_facts.gate: Operational measurements are not long-term capacity reservations.

source_facts.fact: UKPN describes thermal, profiled and voltage flexible connection products that can allow earlier connection while accepting operational restrictions or control.
source_facts.gate: Flexible access is not firm unrestricted capacity and product types must remain distinct.

source_facts.fact: UKPN says its portal exposes thousands of network datasets and nearly 1,000 large-scale generation sites across its London, South East and East of England areas.
source_facts.gate: Open-data visibility is not a signed connection offer or legal boundary survey.

source_facts.fact: UKPN publishes historical quotation and connection service metrics for London Power Networks and its other licence areas.
source_facts.gate: Historic averages are not project-specific timelines.

source_facts.fact: ENA Engineering Recommendation G100 Issue 2 covers customer installations where agreed import/export current limits or voltage-limit controls require a customer limitation scheme or suitable protection.
source_facts.gate: Technical compliance with an export/import limitation scheme does not itself grant network capacity, connection approval or planning permission.

official_measurement_examples.name: NESO connections reform queue snapshot
official_measurement_examples.fact: NESO states the current connections queue is over 738 GW, compared with 200–225 GW of clean generation capacity required by 2030.

official_measurement_examples.name: Ofgem G2tWQ re-baselined timetable
official_measurement_examples.fact: Ofgem's 3 June 2026 decision says Gate 2 offers are being issued in batches through 2026, with the final batch expected by mid-March 2027.

official_measurement_examples.name: NESO offer delivery snapshot 10 June 2026
official_measurement_examples.fact: NESO reported 713 of 1,223 projects in the pre-2030 pipeline had received offers as of 10 June 2026, representing 58% and 37 GW of new electricity capacity.

official_measurement_examples.name: NESO Gate 1 semantics
official_measurement_examples.fact: NESO states a Gate 1 outcome does not reserve capacity, a queue place, protected status or a guaranteed connection.

official_measurement_examples.name: UKPN Super Grid Transformer historical flows
official_measurement_examples.fact: UKPN describes half-hourly Super Grid Transformer historical power-flow data from 2021 to the previous day where available, with daily updates.

official_measurement_examples.name: London Power Networks connection performance 2024/25
official_measurement_examples.fact: UKPN reports 2024/25 average London Power Networks time-to-quote of 13.81 working days for metered demand HV and 32.96 working days for metered demand HV/EHV.

official_measurement_examples.name: UKPN Open Data Portal coverage
official_measurement_examples.fact: UKPN says its portal contains thousands of electricity-network datasets and details of nearly 1,000 large-scale generation sites across London, the South East and East of England.

official_measurement_examples.name: UKPN Trading Connections project
official_measurement_examples.fact: UKPN lists Trading Connections as a £773,000 project running from 1 February 2024 to 31 July 2026 to develop a public tool visualising demand, capacity and queue data across substations.

core_rules: connection queue position is not a guaranteed energisation date
Gate 1 status does not reserve network capacity or guarantee connection
Gate 2 status is not planning permission or construction completion
a connection offer is not proof that all reinforcement works are complete
an accepted connection offer is not the same as an energised connection
an indicative capacity map is not a formal connection offer
substation headroom is time-varying and must not be treated as permanent spare capacity
thermal headroom is not equivalent to fault-level or voltage headroom
generation export headroom is not the same as demand import headroom
transmission capacity evidence must not be substituted for distribution capacity evidence
distribution capacity evidence must not be substituted for final transmission impact assessment
Grid Supply Point data is not parcel geometry or cadastral evidence
Appendix G data is contextual queue evidence and not a site-specific acceptance
queue visibility is not a priority right over other applicants
connections reform policy status must be date-versioned
consultation proposals must not be represented as final enacted connection rules
re-baselined offer timetables are programme milestones and not individual project dates
programme-level percentage of offers issued is not evidence for a specific project offer
national queue capacity must not be downscaled to a London parcel
national Clean Power capacity need must not be downscaled to a substation
battery oversupply in the reformed queue is not proof that a local battery project is non-viable
strategic demand prioritisation proposals do not automatically prioritise a specific development
data-centre policy examples do not determine priority for unrelated demand projects
network reinforcement need is not planning refusal
network reinforcement funding is not proof that reinforcement has been delivered
reinforcement completion is not evidence of immediate spare capacity after other accepted connections
flexible connection availability is not a firm unrestricted capacity guarantee
curtailment forecasts are estimates and not guaranteed future curtailment
historic curtailment is not a deterministic forecast of future curtailment
real-time constraint headroom is operational data and not a long-term connection entitlement
long-term operational windows are scenario estimates and not contractual unrestricted-access periods
LIFO stack position is not a parcel development score
DERMS control capability is not evidence that a project has a signed flexible connection agreement
profiled connections and flexible thermal connections must remain distinct
voltage flexible connections and thermal flexible connections must remain distinct
import limitation and export limitation schemes must remain distinct
G100 compliance does not itself grant a DNO connection approval
G99 technical compliance does not itself provide planning permission
technical standards and commercial connection terms must remain distinct
connection charging information is not a project quotation
average time-to-quote metrics are not a forecast for an individual application
average time-to-connect metrics are not a committed energisation date
customer satisfaction scores are not network-capacity evidence
Open Data Portal asset locations are approximate and not legal land boundaries
System Visualisation Interface locations must not be treated as survey-grade coordinates
half-hourly transformer flow measurements do not prove future maximum demand
historical power flows must not be treated as a future design study
latest half-hour measurement is not a capacity reservation
forecast connection growth is not an accepted project pipeline
innovation project objectives are not deployed business-as-usual capability unless deployment is evidenced
a beta or trial Connections Lab output is not a binding connection offer
self-serve estimate is not a signed bilateral agreement
queue reform removal of non-viable projects does not guarantee earlier connection for every remaining project
advancement fee administrative closure does not alter Gate 1 or Gate 2 outcome unless explicitly stated
code modification effective dates must be preserved and not backdated
older queue statistics must retain their snapshot date
duplicate official pages describing the same programme are one evidence family, not independent corroboration
absence of a public capacity record is NO_DATA and not evidence of no available capacity
source confidence is research-source confidence and not parcel-level connection accuracy
RECOVERY_PARKED forbids parcel relation creation, Future Growth scoring and business promotion
